caption: The drawing depicts a round, flat, perforated object resembling a sieve or strainer with a handle attached at the edge. The main circular portion is beige or light tan with irregular darker patches and spots, and it is evenly dotted with numerous small black holes across its surface. The edge of the circular portion shows slight irregularities and darker outlines, possibly indicating wear or shading. Attached to the upper right side of the circle is a long, metallic gray handle with a brass or gold-colored band near the joint where it connects to the circular portion. The handle extends upward and to the right at a slight angle. There are three small copper or reddish circular rivets located near the edge of the sieve, likely securing the handle. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature "Annie B. Johnston" is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Brass Sugar Skimmer
